text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute blasts down the track.
While
others may not know the driving
force behind her
powerful legs...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that the souls of her
predecessors are
pushing her forward.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... A-Acute?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She's always been an incredible racer,
but today...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... That's right. How could I forget?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Running isn't just about accomplishing
some goal.
That's right, running is like
living...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And you can't just stop living. No, life is
about
experiencing all you can until you
can't anymore...
And I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I have so much more... life to live.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's just like you said. I know you still
have a lot to
show me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And... I still have so much to learn. I'm
only just
getting started...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with that, dearie.
Don't
you fret your pretty little head.
After all...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of time together for
all that,
you and I.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as an Umamusume
who can
run forever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That hasn't changed, and it never will.
That's just
life.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Part of being a racer is knowing that
once you
stop running, you fall out of
the public
consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once the fire inside you goes out, that's
it. That's
when you have no choice but
to throw in the
towel.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Those are the facts... But you know
what?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My fire's not snuffed out yet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's still burning, meaning I can still run—I still want to run.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd be lying if I said I've taught Tarumae

everything I can. And as for me, well...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's just like you said, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I still want to run! I still want to win! ...As
much as I
can, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It's quite obvious, isn't it? Of course you should run if you're healthy, but even if you're not in tip-top shape, that doesn't mean you can't run.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you stumble, you
can still
get back up, again and again
and again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's what the best Umamusume do,
isn't it?
That's what makes someone a
champion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the motivation burning in her
heart
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it may have dimmed for a bit as
she
grappled with the voices inside her
saying her
best days were behind her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heck, even I was about to give up and
resign
myself to simply watching over
her as she
declined...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the fire in her wasn't gone. And
because I
kept fanning those flames...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute has found a reason to
keep
running. And she'll keep running
for a long
time—longer than anyone
else.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer dear. Do you think you
could choose
a good race for me to
make a "re-debut"?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Forget the kotatsu. This year, I'd like to
usher in
the new year from the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'd like to invite Tarumae.
She's the one
who helped me get back
on track, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There is only dirt G1 left this year—one
of the
very pinnacles of the sport.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll be heading back to that hopeful
stage, this
time to prove that Wonder
Acute will be shining
from the top for a
while yet.
choice_data_list_en: Let's go to the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll show everyone that Wonder Acute
is still at
the top, even as new
challengers like Hokko
Tarumae are
approaching the peak.
